study.notes: STUDY: PROXYMO (NCT04019561), Shankar 2024 (Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol, the full paper of the group's 2021 AASLD abstract), reached through the institutional route (ClinicalKey); the baseline table, the blood pressure table, the efficacy table and Methods and Results sentences copied into work/fulltext/companion/shankar2024_proxymo_tables.txt; 19 week randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2a trial, 74 participants with biopsy proven noncirrhotic MASH with fibrosis, randomised 2:1:2:1 to once daily subcutaneous cotadutide 300 ug, cotadutide 600 ug or dose matched placebo (placebo arms pooled, n 24); ITT n 25 per cotadutide arm and 24 placebo (the blood pressure table prints 26 for the 300 ug arm); the primary endpoint is safety (TEAEs), the efficacy measures are secondary (prespecified_endpoint FALSE); efficacy table: LS mean (95% CI) difference versus placebo in change from baseline to week 19 (route ci_95), triglycerides and HMW adiponectin as geometric LS mean percent differences (PCT rows); relative HFF by MRI-PDFF from the Results text, ITT week 19 (the 2021 abstract and the mITT analysis give -30.6 (-55.8 to -5.4) for the 600 ug arm; the ITT value -27 (-46.8 to -7.2) is used here for consistency with the other ITT rows); baselines mean (SD) per arm from the baseline table (no baselines for lipids, blood pressure or pulse in the captured text); pct_weight_change: LS mean difference in body weight versus placebo -2.36 kg (600 ug) over the n weighted baseline weight (102.2*24 + 96.9*25)/49 = 99.5 kg gives -2.37 percent, and -0.44 kg (300 ug) over (102.2*24 + 101.6*25)/49 = 101.9 kg gives -0.43 percent; AstraZeneca sponsored (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall some_concerns

json.design: randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2a trial, 2:1:2:1 to cotadutide 300 ug, 600 ug or dose matched placebo, 19 weeks, 74 randomised, biopsy proven noncirrhotic MASH with fibrosis
json.reason: full paper of the group's 2021 abstract reached through the institutional route (ClinicalKey); replaces the abstract read (3 rows, 600 ug arm, mITT) with 23 rows (12 for the 600 ug arm, 11 for the 300 ug arm) from the efficacy and blood pressure tables with baselines where the baseline table gives them
other_markers: visceral and subcutaneous adipose tissue (unit not printed, no baseline)
NIS4, Pro-C3 and other fibrosis markers (page table 8)

rob.justification: S: the RoB-2 row already recorded applies (double blind randomised; ITT and mITT analyses both reported with 15 of 18 completers in the 600 ug arm at week 19 for HFF, so attrition some concerns; MRI and laboratory outcomes; safety primary with efficacy secondary and reported by arm)

doubts: the ITT efficacy table (n 25 per cotadutide arm, 24 placebo) is used; the abstract's HFF, ALT and AST values are the mITT ones and differ slightly
the 300 ug arm n is printed 25 in the efficacy table and 26 in the blood pressure table
total cholesterol has no unit printed; VAT and SAT have no unit and no baseline and are not extracted
